claim_card.objects: Finite packet decompositions; Banach nonlinear maps and multilinear tree expansions; filtered correction problems; finite graph G-transports; finite self-adjoint Hilbert projector families.
claim_card.conclusion: The 56 explicitly named blocks below support their stated conclusions after the recorded restrictions and local proof completions.
claim_card.hypotheses: Finite packet sets; bounded linear maps where norm estimates use them; C^(m+1), C², closed range and complemented Banach domains where stated; continuous projections for convergent higher-operation series; congruence-preserving complete separated filtrations; specified G-valued gauges; self-adjoint projections and declared time regularity.
claim_card.exceptional_cases: Zero source/multilinear norm; m=0 empty iteration sum; zero module and empty packet family; zero projection members in the smooth section; T=0 identity products; finite length distinguished from finite cardinality.

claims.label: thm:packet_faa
claims.status: passed after the recorded local repairs where applicable
claims.evidence: The partition chain rule is recovered inductively: the new direction either forms a singleton outer slot or joins exactly one existing block. Symmetry makes block enumeration harmless; finite packet insertion adds no factorial.

claims.label: thm:polynomial_tree_expansion
claims.status: passed after the recorded local repairs where applicable
claims.evidence: Closed radius-R ball is complete, invariant, and q-contracting. Finite bounded-height ordered trees equal Picard iterates; nonnegative scalar tree weights increase to a value at most R. This proves absolute convergence of unlabelled tree values.

claims.label: cor:quadratic_tree_expansion
claims.status: passed after the recorded local repairs where applicable
claims.evidence: For a,b>0 the smaller root obeys a+bR²=R and 2bR<1. Cases b=0 and a=0 are separated before dividing; uniqueness is local to the stated ball.

claims.label: thm:packet_tree_reconstruction
claims.status: passed after the recorded local repairs where applicable
claims.evidence: Each finite tree is reconstructed by finite sums at multilinear vertices. Infinite decorated expansions require grouping by the underlying tree; a flattened absolute convergence claim would be false.

claims.label: cor:tree_pruning
claims.status: passed after the recorded local repairs where applicable
claims.evidence: Zero vertex blocks kill the finite decorated value. Removing these zeros preserves each grouped finite sum and thus the grouped series.

claims.label: prop:packet_l_infinity
claims.status: passed after the recorded local repairs where applicable
claims.evidence: Continuity of the packet projectors, now explicit, justifies passage through the convergent arity series. Finite group-label sums occur inside each arity. Completeness by itself is insufficient.

claims.label: thm:defect_composition_identity
claims.status: passed after the recorded local repairs where applicable
claims.evidence: Add and subtract G_c(C_Y F_f(x)); its argument is exactly F_c(C_X x)+Delta_F(x). The Lipschitz estimate uses these two arguments.

claims.label: thm:iterated_orbit_defect
claims.status: passed after the recorded local repairs where applicable
claims.evidence: e_0=0 and e_(n+1)<=epsilon_n+q e_n yield the displayed powers in their correct order, including the empty n=0 sum.

claims.label: thm:fixed_point_stability
claims.status: passed after the recorded local repairs where applicable
claims.evidence: Both fixed-point identities give mismatch<=epsilon+q mismatch, hence the stated denominator for q<1.

claims.label: cor:multilevel_fixed_points
claims.status: passed after the recorded local repairs where applicable
claims.evidence: The sum telescopes through C_(0,l)x_l and uses bounded linear coarsenings. C_(a,a)=I supplies the first term and empty chain.

claims.label: thm:relative_obstruction_sequence
claims.status: passed after the recorded local repairs where applicable
claims.evidence: Checked connecting-lift independence and exactness at every kernel/cokernel term by representative chase; signs agree with D_f u_f=i_V v_0.

claims.label: thm:cone_obstruction
claims.status: passed after the recorded local repairs where applicable
claims.evidence: Cone differential squares to zero because D is a cochain map. Boundary (e,0)=d(eprime,c) means e=d_E eprime+D c and d_C c=0, exactly the cohomological image criterion.

claims.label: thm:right_inverse_correction
claims.status: passed after the recorded local repairs where applicable
claims.evidence: With explicitly bounded linear R and closed im D, range R is closed, Psi is q-Lipschitz, the radius condition gives invariance, and solutions inside range R are precisely fixed points.

claims.label: cor:correction_stability
claims.status: passed after the recorded local repairs where applicable
claims.evidence: Subtract the two fixed-point equations in the same invariant ball, use ||R|| and q, and divide by 1-q.

claims.label: thm:lyapunov_schmidt
claims.status: passed after the recorded local repairs where applicable
claims.evidence: Closed direct summands are Banach spaces with bounded projections. The derivative in X_1 is the stated Banach isomorphism; the local implicit graph supplies the range equation and zero first derivatives on K.

claims.label: cor:quadratic_reduced_obstruction
claims.status: passed after the recorded local repairs where applicable
claims.evidence: C² is explicit. All Dpsi(0) terms vanish, and pi_O L D²psi(0)=0 because im L=R.

claims.label: def:depth_obstruction
claims.status: passed after the recorded local repairs where applicable
claims.evidence: Filtration congruence preservation and L_m(F^(m+1)X) subset F^(m+1)Y make the defect and correction classes well typed; finite length is now distinguished from finite cardinality.

claims.label: thm:one_step_lifting
claims.status: passed after the recorded local repairs where applicable
claims.evidence: The first-order congruence is equivalent to Lbar_m[h]=-[Phi(x_m)]. A nonempty solution set is a kernel coset over modules, and an affine space only over a field.

claims.label: cor:finite_branch_count
claims.status: passed after the recorded local repairs where applicable
claims.evidence: Finite vector spaces over a finite field ensure actual finite cardinalities; the nonempty kernel coset has |ker Lbar_m| elements.

claims.label: lem:well_defined_lift_classes
claims.status: passed after the recorded local repairs where applicable
claims.evidence: Changing the parent representative translates its correction coordinate. Equality modulo F^(m+1)X is exactly equality of correction classes; congruence preservation keeps the child solution condition invariant.

claims.label: def:lift_tree
claims.status: passed after the recorded local repairs where applicable
claims.evidence: Vertices are solution congruence classes, not raw representatives; reduction gives a unique parent and fixes the root class.

claims.label: thm:finitely_branching_lift_tree
claims.status: passed after the recorded local repairs where applicable
claims.evidence: Finite branching and nonempty levels allow the successive infinite-descendant choice. Compatible representatives are Cauchy, and the separate complete-lifting argument applies.

claims.label: cor:unique_lift_branch
claims.status: passed after the recorded local repairs where applicable
claims.evidence: A zero kernel leaves at most one correction class at each stage; the proof now uses module coset terminology consistently.

claims.label: thm:complete_filtered_lifting
claims.status: passed after the recorded local repairs where applicable
claims.evidence: Compatibility gives eventual membership of differences in every F^rX; completeness gives a limit. Each F^rY is an open and closed subgroup; continuity and separatedness force Phi(limit)=0.

claims.label: prop:maurer_cartan_lifting
claims.status: passed after the recorded local repairs where applicable
claims.evidence: For degree-one eta,h, graded skew symmetry makes the mixed bracket equal [eta,h]. Since m>=1, F^(2m) lies in F^(m+1); the bracket/differential preserve the graded correction domain.

claims.label: fact:filtered_spectral_sequence
claims.status: passed after the recorded local repairs where applicable
claims.evidence: Finite decreasing filtration by subcomplexes agrees with the checked Stacks construction, E0/E1 indexing, functoriality, and convergence to graded cohomology.

claims.label: prop:fine_obstruction_survival
claims.status: passed after the recorded local repairs where applicable
claims.evidence: Survival means a nonzero permanent class modulo later boundaries. E1 degeneration detects zero total cohomology because the induced filtration is finite; it does not split extensions canonically.

claims.status: passed after the recorded local repairs where applicable
claims.evidence: The corrected Banach setup includes F_Q(u0,v0)=0 and phi(u0)=v0. The implicit graph and retained equation are then equivalent to the full local zero equation.

claims.evidence: Differentiate the hidden equation through the basepoint graph: Dphi=-A^(-1)D_uF_Q. Substitution in the retained derivative gives the stated order of factors.

claims.evidence: Twice differentiating the hidden equation gives A D²phi=-D²F_Q[hhat,khat]. Substitution into the retained chain rule yields both displayed formulas without dropping D_vF_P.

findings.failure: Bounded right inverse was not explicitly required to be linear although operator-norm estimates use linearity.
findings.repair: State bounded linear right inverse R.

findings.failure: Finite length was used to suggest finiteness of the obstruction class/cardinality. A one-dimensional vector space over R has finite length and infinite cardinality.
findings.repair: State finite length of the cokernel; reserve finite cardinality for finite graded pieces.

findings.failure: Completeness alone does not permit discontinuous projections to commute with an infinite limit.
findings.repair: Require continuous packet projectors and use continuity in the proof.

findings.failure: The unlabelled absolute majorant cannot justify a flattened sum of all oblique packet decorations.
findings.repair: Keep the finite decoration sum grouped inside each underlying tree.

counterexample.unlabelled_sum: (1/8,1/64); every original tree with at least 3 leaves vanishes
counterexample.flattened_failure: Every left-comb tree decorated entirely by P1 has value (1/8,0), independent of the number of leaves, so the flattened terms do not tend to zero.

findings.failure: The IFT setup omitted a zero value of the hidden equation at the designated basepoint.
findings.counterexample: F_Q(u,v)=exp(v) at (0,0) has invertible v derivative 1 and no zero anywhere.
findings.repair: Specify Banach source/target factors, F_Q(u0,v0)=0, A a Banach isomorphism, and phi(u0)=v0.

findings.failure: The proof called a correction coset an affine space although the setting allows general modules.
findings.repair: Use a coset of the kernel.

findings.issue: Orthogonal must mean self-adjoint Hilbert projections, rather than only pairwise annihilating idempotents.

counterexample_if_omitted.failure: K is not skew-adjoint and U(t) is not unitary for t != 0.

findings.issue: U*U=I gives only isometry in infinite dimension, but the proof immediately asserts unitarity and uses U inverse.
findings.minimal_repair: Invoke continuous bounded-ODE propagator invertibility U(t,s)^(-1)=U(s,t) before combining with U*U=I.

findings.issue: Rightmost-first path transport is homomorphic only for a matching pi_1 multiplication convention.
findings.minimal_repair: Define gamma_2 gamma_1 to traverse gamma_1 first, then gamma_2.

findings.issue: Only standing C1 hypotheses are present, but proof invokes C2 and Lipschitz convergence theorems.
findings.minimal_repair: Qualify convergence by hypotheses of the respective convergence theorems, or assume C2 for the corollary.
findings.scope_preserving_alternative: Under C1, use uniform o(h) expansions for direct polar rotation, exact propagator, and frozen exponential, then unitary telescoping. This proves convergence without O(mesh) rate.

findings.issue: P=0 or I gives a zero packet forbidden by earlier packet definition; zero H permits empty family and undefined maximum.
findings.minimal_repair: Omit zero projection summands; define delta=max({0} union {||P_alpha-Q_alpha||}).

findings.issue: Section begins without naming a parameter interval; strict partitions implicitly have positive duration.
findings.minimal_repair: Specify [0,T], T>=0; empty partition product is I when T=0.

dependency_graph: Finite inverse analysis/synthesis -> exact coordinates -> finite jets -> partition composition.

Multilinear norm telescoping + invariant complete ball -> contraction fixed point; finite-height Picard trees + scalar nonnegative majorant -> unlabelled absolute series; finite packet insertion -> grouped decorated series.

Linear correction quotient -> associated graded cokernel test; congruence preservation -> representative-independent child classes; finite branching -> branch; completeness + continuity + separatedness -> exact limit solution.

Banach implicit function theorem + zero hidden basepoint + invertible hidden derivative -> local graph -> first/second Schur derivatives. Closed complementary range/kernel gives the Lyapunov Schmidt specialization.
Finite filtered-complex construction + finite convergence -> permanent classes and zero detection, without a canonical extension splitting.

Tree normalization + matching path order -> graph gauge classification. Self-adjoint packet identities -> skew generator -> invertible unitary evolution; positive two-sided overlaps -> direct polar rotation; C² local estimates + unitary telescoping -> O(mesh) convergence.

external_source_checks.translation: Take the product factors as retained/hidden Banach variables. The implicit graph preserves the basepoint value, so a zero graph requires that value to be zero. Smoothness is inherited. This external source revision is not the Paper III pinned dependency.
Apply the Banach-valued one-variable integral formula to t maps to F(x+th) on [0,1], with m+1 continuous derivatives. Finite packet projection is bounded.

Use the abelian category of modules, K=C, the same decreasing filtration, and total degree n=p+q. The finite filtration ensures convergence to the induced graded cohomology. No extension splitting is inferred.
